literal: Family 'I will uplift' who says to a person, divine power waist-cloth having tied itself will step forward.
translation: When a person resolves, 'I will uplift my family,' the divine power itself will gird its loins and step forward to help.
modern: என் குடியை நான் உயர்த்துவேன் என்று உறுதிகொண்டு செயல்படும் ஒருவனுக்கு, தெய்வமே தன் ஆடையை வரிந்துகட்டிக்கொண்டு முன்வந்து உதவும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the powerful support available to someone dedicated to their family's welfare. The phrase 'குடி செய்வல்' means 'I will uplift my family,' showing strong personal resolve. In response to such determination, 'தெய்வம்' (divine power or fate) does not merely watch but actively assists. The vivid idiom 'மடி தற்று' (girding the waist-cloth) portrays the divine power rolling up its sleeves, ready for hard work. Thus, the couplet teaches that unwavering commitment to one's lineage naturally attracts powerful, unforeseen assistance.
